groups.title: Missed publishing
groups.note: Payments omitted from the originally published reports. Includes Felinesoft Ltd, both added payments labelled CLOSED Clearcourse Membership Services Ltd (Felinesoft) and published payments renamed to that name, AECOM payments that were added or removed, payments to North Somerset Council, payments to Avon Pension Fund, and payments to Bath & North East Somerset Council General Suspense Account, including the published payment renamed to Bristol City Council. There are no changed AECOM payments in the diff. North Somerset Enterprise Agency is not included. Also Carlisle Staffing Plc T/A Guidant Global, Building Research Establishment, Placecube, Pixie Energy, Opinion Research Services, Comensura, and Constellia, including added rows and rows renamed to or from those names. Also Data Cubed Ltd, Gloucestershire County Council, Graham Tate T/A Exceptional Development, Grant Thornton, Grant Thornton UK LLP, HMRC, ICO, South Gloucestershire Council, Spark South West, University of Bath, University of the West of England, and WSP UK Limited.

groups.title: Indidividual 1
groups.note: Payments to Y E Elsorougi, including added payments, payments un-redacted from Redacted - Sole Trader, and payments whose corrected supplier is a redaction of that name.

groups.title: Transport renames
groups.note: Already published payments renamed to C T Coaches Ltd, from Redacted - Sole Trader, C T Coaches (Susan Young & David Young T/A), or C T Coaches, payments renamed from The Big Lemon to Big Lemon Bristol and The West LTD, payments renamed from Eurotaxis Ltd to Eurocoaches Ltd, payments renamed from Faresaver Buses to Faresaver Ltd, the payment renamed from Turners Coachways Ltd to Turners Coachways (Bristol) Ltd, and payments renamed from Click Travel Ltd to Perk UK Ltd. New payments to these suppliers stay in Transport operators.

groups.title: AtkinsRéalis
groups.note: Payments to Atkins Limited or AtkinsRéalis UK Limited. Added rows are new payments. Changed rows are the same payment with the supplier name updated, including where the accent in Réalis was stored as a different character. Farrelly Atkinson is not included.

groups.title: Core Funding monthly payments
groups.note: Added Core Funding payments described as Government Departments. These are the repeating payments to Bristol City Council.
groups.percent_note: The change is this group's total divided by the £151,751.25 already published under Core Funding.

groups.title: Central government monthly payments
groups.note: Added Funding from Central Government payments described as Government Departments, paid to Bristol City Council or to the Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government.
groups.percent_note: The change is this group's total divided by the £134,372.69 already published under Funding from Central Government.

groups.title: Capital grants
groups.note: Added payments described as Capital Grants, mostly to the councils, colleges, and energy companies. Also the eight Agencies or Public Bodies payments to the Department for Business, Energy and Industrial Strategy, the Department for Energy Security and Net Zero, and the Cabinet Office. Agency staff costs are not included.

groups.title: Grants
groups.note: Added payments whose purpose is Grants. Most of the money is Employment and Skills, paid to the colleges and the councils. This is separate from Capital Grants.

groups.title: Transport operators
groups.note: Added payments whose purpose is Transport Operators, almost all in Integrated Transport. First West of England Ltd is the largest recipient.

groups.title: Other local authorities
groups.note: Added payments whose purpose is Other Local Authorities, mostly to Bath and North East Somerset, South Gloucestershire, Bristol, and North Somerset.

groups.title: Professional fees project
groups.note: Added payments whose purpose is Professional Fees Project. Network Rail is most of the total, then WSP.

groups.title: Payments to others
groups.note: Added payments whose purpose is Payments to Others, almost all to the three councils.

groups.title: Supplier name changes
groups.note: Changes where the supplier name was changed, but those payments do not appear to be connected with many other added payments.
groups.percent_note: The payment amount did not change. Only the supplier name did.

groups.title: Redacted supplier
groups.note: An already published payment whose corrected supplier is a redaction, or where the original supplier name was a redaction. Payments that appear only in the corrected file are not included.
